notes.content: [h2]Hello Again!![/h2][p]Today we are adding Voice chat to the game. Voice chat is set to [i]Open Mic[/i] by default but can be changed to [i]Push to Talk (V) [/i]in the settings. If you want to report any issues or ideas, then please join us in our [b][url="https://discord.gg/FZANNvc5Mp"]Discord[/url][/b]![/p][p]Once again many thanks for all of the support and we hope you will enjoy the game with your friends![/p][p][/p][h2]Features[/h2][list][*][p]Proximity Voice Chat[/p][list][*][p]Set to Open Mic by default, can be changed to [i]Push to Talk[/i] within the settings, which can be triggered using the [i]V[/i]-Key.[/p][/*][*][p]Voice chat volume can be adjusted within the settings[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: FINAL SPIN V2.1.5
notes.content: [h2]Hello everyone!![/h2][p]It has been a while, we are very sorry but we have been very busy working on our [b]New Co-op Game[/b] [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3331590/OLAPU/"][b]OLAPU[/b][/url]! We would be really happy if you could check it out and [b]Wishlist it[/b]! [/p][p]FINAL SPIN and the community around it is very important to us so we wanted to add some new content to it! A feature heavily requested by you guys has been the addition of [b]Emotes. [/b]As such we have now added [b]12 new emotes[/b] to the game! Ranging from [i]Waving[/i] and [i]Pointing[/i], all the way to [i]Rock, Paper, Scissors[/i]. These emotes can be accessed using the [i]Tab-[/i]Key. Additionally we have now introduced [b]Steal on Kill[/b][i], [/i]this setting is enabled by default and allows the player who eliminated another player to steal their items. Some Quality of Life changes and bug fixes have also been introduced, which were asked for by the community on [url="https://discord.gg/FZANNvc5Mp"][b]Discord[/b][/url]![/p][p]We hope you will be enjoying the update together with your friends! [b]Don't forget to update your game![/b][/p][p]Thanks to everyone who has been supporting us and been enjoying the game, we are very thankful to all of you!![/p][p][/p][p]For more information, view the patch notes below:[/p][h2]Emotes[/h2][list][*][p]Emotes can now be accessed using the [i]Tab-[/i]Key.[/p][/*][*][p]You can choose between the following [b]12[/b] emotes:[/p][list][*][p]Fingergun[/p][/*][*][p]Love[/p][/*][*][p]Peace[/p][/*][*][p]Point[/p][/*][*][p]Raise Hand[/p][/*][*][p]Scared[/p][/*][*][p]Shrug[/p][/*][*][p]Thumbs Down[/p][/*][*][p]Thumbs Up[/p][/*][*][p]Wave[/p][/*][*][p]Clap[/p][/*][*][p]Rock, Paper, Scissors[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Features[/h2][list][*][p]Steal on Kill has been introduced as a Game Setting. It allows the player who eliminates another player to steal all of their items.[/p][/*][*][p]Controller Support has been added to the entire Game UI.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Quality of Life and Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]You can no longer view credits of other players on their Black Market Display.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that would angle items wrongly sometimes when dragged on your inventory slots.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where stealing items would sometimes cause certain inventory slots to no longer be accessible.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: FINAL SPIN V2.0
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone!!!![/h2]
[previewyoutube=FKKoe9cD3Qc;full][/previewyoutube]
Before we get to the patch notes we would like to say how thankful we are to all of you for the support FINAL SPIN has received ever since its release :) It has been mind blowing to us and we could have never imagined it! So from the two of us, many many thanks!! 

We also now have a discord, join us now: [url=https://discord.gg/FZANNvc5Mp]Discord[/url]

This is our largest update to date and is set to release on the 23rd of November!
Now for the changes. We have added fully new gameplay mechanics, the black market, new items, many quality of life changes, and much more! For more information, see the patch notes below:

[h2]Black Market[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031809/64a74654d13244695a5072aff7b0163fac137cba.gif[/img]
Players now have access to the Black Market.
[list]
[*]Added credits that are gained throughout the game and can be exchanged for certain effects on the Black Market.
Black Market effects:
[list]
[*]Reverse: Reverse the turn order.
[*]Item: Receive a random Item.
[*]Bonus: Change one field on the wheel to bonus. 
[*]Equality: Distribute all items equally between all players.
[*]Item Phase: Skip to the next Item Phase.
[*]Green: Next successful item bet triggers the green effect.
[/list]
[h2]Items[/h2]
Three new items have been added to the item-pool. The Coin Pouch, Scale and the Ouroboros.
[h3]Coin Pouch:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Red/Black: [/b] Gain four credits.
[*][b]Green: [/b] Gain nine credits.
[/list]
[h3]Scale:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Red/Black: [/b] Swap health points with a random player.
[*][b]Green: [/b] Swap health points with the most healthy player.
[/list]
[h3]Ouroboros:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Black: [/b] Swap all player items in turn order.
[*][b]Red: [/b] Swap all player items in reverse turn order.
[*][b]Green: [/b] Swap all player items twice in turn order.
[/list]
[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added a mechanic to steal a players items upon eliminating them.
[*]Main wheel now resets early if only misses are left.
[*]Added a score counter for players indicating their performance across games.
[/list]
[h2]Game Settings[/h2]
Added game settings to customize the rules of the game.
[list]
[*]Toggle Steal Items On Kill.
[*]Toggle Black Market.
[*]Adjust average bullet count in each round.
[*]Adjust amount of health points.
[*]Adjust turn timer.
[*]Adjust enabled Items.
[/list]
[h2]Quality of life[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added an AFK Timer with 5 different options: off, 30 sec, 60 sec, 90 sec and 120 sec. 
[*]Added options for fullscreen modes.
[*]Added better indicators to improve gameplay experience.
[/list]

notes.title: PATCH V1.2.10
notes.content:
[h2]Hello!!!!![/h2]
First of all we would like to say many thanks to all of the incredible support that we have received since the games release :) All of the feedback has been astonishing and we are happy that so many people are enjoying our little game! [b]Thank you![/b] For this update we used your feedback and have added many things that were heavily requested by you guys. On top of that we are doing a [b]20% discount from the 5th-12th of august![/b] So this is the perfect time to [b]invite your friends[/b]!

Finally, we would also want to thank all of the [b]Content Creators[/b] who have been playing our game. It has been incredibly fun to both watch the videos and streams and also to read all of the comments :) Many many thanks![/b]

[h2]Matchmaking[/h2]
[list]
[*]A server browser has been added to the menu that allows finding public lobbies of other players.
[*]An option has been added to change the visibility of your lobby between: [i]Private[/i], [i]Friends Only[/i] and [i]Public[/i]. This setting is set to [i]Friends Only[/i] by default.
[/list]
[h2]Items[/h2]
Two new items have been added to the item-pool. These include the Claw and the Circuit Board.
[h3]Claw[/h3]
The Claw allows the player to steal other players items.
[list]
[*][b]Red/Black: [/b] Steal an item off of a random player.
[*][b]Green: [/b] Steal an item off of each player.[/list]
[h3]Circuit Board[/h3]
Makes the player gain additional turns.
[list]
[*][b]Red/Black: [/b] Gain one additional turn.
[*][b]Green: [/b] Gain two additional turns
[/list]
[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that would allow players to click the confirm button multiple times in some rare scenarios.
[*]Fixed button click animations for clients
[*]Fixed a bug that would cause the game not to load for one person, if the start game button was pressed right after somebody joined.
[*]Item descriptions have been made more readable.
[*]Minor Localization Fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch V1.1.2
notes.content:
[h3]Hi![/h3]
This patch primarily focuses on improvements for the Hourglass Item. But also fixes some bugs.
Once again many thanks for all the positive reviews and useful feedback :)

[h3]HOURGLASS[/h3]
The Hourglass was useless whenever only two people were left in a game. To improve this we introduced the following changes:
[list]
[*]If only two people are left alive in a game, the hourglass now makes the player gain an extra turn.
[*]This also means that the hourglass is now once again available in two player mode.
[/list]
[h3]BUGFIXES[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that would cause the Mouse Sensitivity Slider to visually be maxed out by default.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch V1.1.1

notes.title: PATCH V1.1.0
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone![/h3]

Before we get to the patch notes, we wanted to say that we are incredibly thankful for all the great reviews, community posts and general feedback we have received from you guys so far. [b]Thank you very much![/b] We would have never expected all of this positive support and are incredibly happy that everyone is enjoying the game!

With all that being said here are the patch notes for Version 1.1.0:

[h3]Achievements[/h3]
The following Achievements have now been added to the game:
[list]
[*][b]CASHOUT[/b] - Win a game.
[*][b]FLAWLESS [/b]- Win a game with full Health.
[*][b]BEGINNER'S LUCK[/b] - Successfully bet an item 5 times in a row.
[*][b]0.28%[/b] - Hit green two times in a row.
[*][b]0.014579384%[/b] - Hit green three times in a row. [b](I like those odds)[/b]
[*][b]OVERKILL[/b] - Deal more damage than your opponent has health.
[*][b]ONE SHOT[/b] - Kill an enemy with full health in a single blow.
[*][b]CLOSE CALL[/b] - Win with one health remaining.
[*][b]UNLUCKY [/b]- Miss five shots in a row.
[*][b]BACK FROM THE DEAD[/b] - Heal from one to full health at once.
[*][b]AGAINST ALL ODDS[/b] - At one health, survive four attacks.
[*][b]GAMBLER'S FALLACY[/b] - Complete all achievements.
[/list]
To all of you completionists, we wish the best of luck! Some of the achievements might be near impossible but we would love to be proven otherwise!

[h3]Quality of Life Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added a Zoom-Function. Can be triggered by right-clicking or with the right shoulder button on a gamepad.
[*]Made Item Name and Description more legible
[*]Removed the Hourglass-Item from the Item Pool if playing with only two players, as it was useless.
[/list]
